Write focused failing Rust/Python tests proving native-only failure/shortcut behavior, EOS/domain rejection, tilt invariants, force/JVP parity requirements, and a nontrivial logarithmic-density scale-factor smoke trajectory.

Extract modular PyO3 adapters, preserve existing public call shapes, and update route classification only after native GREEN.
Compose one RF-02C trajectory with native matter, typed physical-domain termination, and 1-thread/N-thread deterministic results.
Run only RF-03 unit, hostile, integration and determinism selectors plus directly invalidated RF-02C interface tests.
Generate and read the bounded numerical figure set; run sign/normalization/domain/fallback mutations and narrow the claim.
Perform PHYS-MATH then PHYS-MATH-CODE audit once; repair only reproduced P0/P1 findings.
